title: Validation layer Pydantic schemas & input sanitization

test_cases.name: Valid payload schema pass
test_cases.input_setup: Validate well-formed clinical dictionary through SchemaValidator
test_cases.expected_result: Passes validation cleanly; returns sanitized instance
test_cases.evidence: Well-formed clinical output validated with zero errors

test_cases.name: Non-dict payload rejection
test_cases.expected_result: Rejection payload generated specifying expected dictionary
test_cases.evidence: Invalid payload rejected: Extraction data must be a dictionary, received list

test_cases.name: Type coercion resilience
test_cases.input_setup: Pass numeric integer 48 into string duration field
test_cases.expected_result: Coerced cleanly to string '48' without crashing

test_cases.name: Malicious and extra fields stripping
test_cases.input_setup: Submit dictionary containing unrecognized / injection keys
test_cases.expected_result: Extra keys stripped; only valid schema fields retained
test_cases.evidence: Extraneous / malicious injection keys cleanly stripped from validated model dump

test_cases.name: High-performance schema validation latency
test_cases.input_setup: Measure average validation latency across 500 validations
test_cases.evidence: High-performance validation: average 5.6 µs per record (< 0.5 ms)
